name: Durban
blurb: Conversation about Durban is up 178% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Good value compared with last year
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
Easy to get around without a car
negative: Prices noticeably up on last season
Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: Not the easiest place to reach, which is probably why it is still calm.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
